title: fix(app-shell): Home's activity card names each row's object by its label, through the bell's resolver (objectui#12238)
body:
Fixes #12238
Clause-②: no

Home's activity card printed each row's object by its API name (`3 hours ago · crm_lead`). It now renders the same `ActivityObjectLabel` the bell's Activity tab has rendered since objectui#12212, so both surfaces name an object one way: the label in the reader's language, the API name only as the fallback. One component, not a second resolver; nothing is copied into `sys_activity`.

Written by the os-dev run dispatched from the `domain:ui` seat 2, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01G5TSaEwbEQsKMjhzTB4rEd`.

## What changed

- **`packages/app-shell/src/layout/ActivityObjectLabel.tsx` (new).** `ActivityObjectLabel` moves here out of `InboxPopover.tsx`: the same function body (now `export`ed) and its docstring, with one paragraph added naming Home as the second consumer. Its private `nonEmpty` helper moves with it. ⛔ Not added to `layout/index.ts` or the package entry, so the published surface is unchanged.
- **`layout/InboxPopover.tsx`.** Imports the component from the new module and drops the imports only it used (`useObjectLabel`, `findByName`, `metadataText`). Nothing else changes.
- **`console/home/HomeRail.tsx`, `HomeActivity`.** The row's second line: FROM `timeAgo(a.timestamp, displayLocale) · {a.objectName}` TO the same time, then `ActivityObjectLabel` with `objectName={a.objectName}`. Two docstrings amended: `HomeActivity` now names the resolver, and `HomeContinue`'s sentence that this module "does not itself load the metadata cache" now names the activity card's one read (the object list, only while a row is on screen), which this change would otherwise have made false.
- **`.changeset/12238-home-activity-object-label.md`**: `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`.

## Measured before building

- **Location, by the package's own convention.** `layout/` already holds the activity and inbox modules that other directories import and the barrel leaves out: `layout/activityItemType.ts` (read by `hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts`) and `layout/inboxGrouping.ts` (read by `hooks/useHomeInbox.ts`). `console/home/` already imports from `../../layout/`.
- **Providers.** `/home` mounts `HomeRoute` inside `ProtectedRoute`, which wraps `ConnectedShell`, whose inner component mounts `MetadataProvider`. `I18nProvider` wraps `App` in `apps/console/src/main.tsx`. The bell already renders this component in the same subtree: `HomeLayout` mounts `AppHeader variant="home"`, which mounts `InboxPopover`. Outside a provider, `useMetadata` and the two i18n hooks fall back without throwing; the existing `HomeActivity.readingStates-12081` suite renders bare and stays green.
- **No third surface.** `layout/ActivityFeed.tsx` renders no `objectName` and has no in-tree mount. The `CommandPalette` hit on `objectName` is a cmdk filter value, not display text.

## Tests

New pin `console/home/__tests__/HomeActivity.objectLabel-12238.test.tsx`, shaped like the bell's `InboxPopover.activityObjectLabel-12212.test.tsx`: real `HomeActivity`, real `I18nProvider`, and a fixed `MetadataCtx` whose `objects` read is counted. Its cells:

- en: `crm_lead` with a `Lead` definition reads `Lead`.
- zh-CN: it reads `线索` from the bundle.
- `crm_gone`, which has no definition and no bundle entry, reads `crm_gone`.
- The summary renders as sent.
- A card with no row reads no object list, and a card with rows reads it.

The bell's pin is unchanged, with no assertion edited, and it is green.

### Ablation (direction written in the test header before the run)

The old line was planted back through `ablation-replace.mjs`: anchor hits went x1 → x0, replacement x0 → x1, blob `87321257e45f` → `dfa072c29798`. Wrapped run of the Home pin:

```text
× en: a business object is named by its label, not its API name       (expected 'crm_lead' to be 'Lead')
× zh-CN: the label comes from the object translation bundle             (expected 'crm_lead' to be '线索')
× a card with no row reads no object list; a card with rows reads it    (never read with rows on screen: expected 0 to be greater than 0)
Tests  3 failed | 2 passed (5)
```

The fallback and summary cells stayed green, as predicted. The restore is proven rather than assumed: the blob after restore equals the HEAD blob `87321257e45f`, `git diff HEAD` is empty, and `git status --porcelain` prints 0 lines. The restored run of both pins: `Tests 11 passed (11)`.

### Local runs

At `3c8e2eb4`, the code commit (HEAD `7217af89` adds only the changeset file):

- Dependency closure: `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...` gave 28/28 tasks, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `vitest run` over `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/`, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/`, `chrome/KeyboardShortcutsDialog.wiredOnly-11674.test.tsx` and `hooks/__tests__/sharedInboxFeed.twoSurfaces.test.tsx`: `Test Files 84 passed (84)`, `Tests 595 passed (595)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exited 0. `--listFiles` on `tsconfig.test.json` lists the new test file (1 hit) and the bell's (1 hit).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint` exited 0 with 0 errors. No warning falls on a line this PR adds; the one `HomeRail.tsx` warning is the pre-existing `TFn` `any`.

At `7217af89`, these all exited 0: control-bytes, new-line-citations (0 new), vi-mock-inherit, vi-mock-specifiers, vi-mock-override-shape, test-path-roots, changeset-no-major, changeset-presence, changeset-claims, pending-changeset-literals, unreferenced-sources, phantom-deps, unused-deps, self-import, type-check:coverage, lint:coverage and i18n-keys.

Narrowing declared: the vitest set is the two directories plus the two tests outside them that import the bell or Home modules. The rest of `pnpm test` is CI's. NOT MEASURED locally:

- `check:eager-closure`: it weighs a full `apps/console` production build, which is CI's Bundle Analysis job.
- `check:readme-exports`: it refused on a prerequisite, unbuilt packages outside this closure. This PR touches no README or export.

## Acceptance notes

- `nonEmpty` now lives privately in three modules: `hooks/useNavTargetLabel.ts`, `hooks/useRecentItemLabel.ts` and `layout/ActivityObjectLabel.tsx`. That is the same count as before this PR, when the third copy was in `InboxPopover.tsx`. It is not consolidated here. Carrier: none.
